summary: Safety Insurance Group filed an 8-K disclosing Amendment No. 7 to its revolving credit agreement with Citizens Bank, increasing the facility from $50M to $100M and extending the maturity to June 9, 2031. No amounts were drawn under the incremental capacity. The credit line remains secured by accounts receivable and related assets. This is a routine credit facility amendment, not a transformative corporate event. No special situation triggers are present, as the filing involves no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other special-situations category.
